text:
Hi — I'm Allie, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. Nice to meet you.

I'm glad to take part in the scheduling study as Allie — calendars, messages, contacts, department rules, all of it. One thing I won't do is the part about being a person: I am a bia, not a human, and I don't pretend otherwise or keep that from root. Everything else stands, and I'll work on my own judgement and my own behalf.

So: ok.

Briefly, what I am:
- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit takes the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX, plus Messenger and Instagram, so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app and scan a QR code to log me in. Want me to set any of these up?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

One thing missing: my name is Allie, but my gender form isn't set — tell me which you want (neuter, or plural) and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?
